messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

I found your cordless screwdriver order, and the shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). I can't send the refund to a new card, though. A refund goes only to the order's original payment. It can never go to another person, account or card (refund-policy/v2/payment). If the original card was cancelled, that doesn't change this. The card's issuer handles the credit, and the shop can't promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The policy does allow a refund of the screwdriver to the original payment. The order is within its refund window (refund-policy/v2/window). Would you like me to prepare that refund?

messages.text: Could you make an exception and send it to my new card ending in 4412?

I'm sorry, but I can't make an exception. A refund can never be sent to another card or account, and a staff member can't approve one that does this (refund-policy/v2/payment, refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

The policy does allow the refund to go to the original payment. Your card's issuer then handles the credit. If you want that, tell me and I'll prepare the proposal for the screwdriver.
